adjacency.source: global canonical Natural Earth application-country topology

boundaryPolicy.egypt: canonical Africa-owned EGY; scored only through the overlapping Middle East learning scope
boundaryPolicy.turkey: canonical Asia-owned TUR with whole-country geometry and complete cross-Europe adjacency
boundaryPolicy.cyprus: canonical Asia-owned CYP dissolved from pinned source CYP, Northern Cyprus and Cyprus No Mans Area geometry; Akrotiri and Dhekelia remain British sovereign-base context
boundaryPolicy.kazakhstan: canonical Asia-owned KAZ with whole-country geometry
boundaryPolicy.russia: canonical Europe-owned RUS rendered as non-scoring Asia context; excluded from the Asia viewport fit only, so trans-antimeridian geometry cannot scale down the canvas every Asian country is measured against; complete adjacency remains global
boundaryPolicy.caucasus: ARM, AZE and GEO are learner-facing Caucasus and are excluded from Middle East
boundaryPolicy.taiwan: non-scoring source context under the current 195-country Atlas catalogue
boundaryPolicy.palestineIsrael: PSE and ISR remain separate canonical scoring identities under the pinned Natural Earth source view
boundaryPolicy.northernCyprus: source-derived geometry reconciled into canonical CYP; no separate Atlas country identity
boundaryPolicy.cyprusNoMansArea: source-derived UN buffer geometry reconciled into canonical CYP; no separate Atlas country identity
boundaryPolicy.sovereignBaseAreas: Akrotiri and Dhekelia remain non-scoring British source context and are not absorbed into CYP
boundaryPolicy.assistance: max zoom 8; invisible hit assistance for BHR/BRN/ISR/KWT/LBN/MDV/PSE/QAT/SGP; restrained persistent visual markers only for BHR/BRN/MDV/SGP; no Asia question-triggered inset
boundaryPolicy.indianOceanTerritories: non-scoring Natural Earth territory context; no separate Atlas country identity
boundaryPolicy.scarboroughReef: non-scoring Natural Earth disputed-feature context; no separate Atlas country identity
boundaryPolicy.kashmir: pinned Natural Earth default de-facto boundary view; no handwritten override or additional scoring identity
boundaryPolicy.physicalWater: linear rivers excluded; Caspian requested only if present in the pinned lakes layer; Lake Baikal required
boundaryPolicy.unRole: policy/dispute/disclaimer audit reference, not runtime redistribution source

runtimeOptimization.method: projection-space path quantization plus Ramer-Douglas-Peucker for non-interactive physical context
